name: Multi-target VS benchmark
description: Per-target benchmark data for the article "Virtual ligand screening by LLM agents: expert guidance changes the screened library, not the ranking" (Osman Gani, submitted to Journal of Cheminformatics, October 2026). Eleven protein targets across six classes: FPR2, EGFR, CDK2, COX-2, ESR1, DPP-4, AChE, BACE-1, HSP90, p38 and thrombin, each with 100 curated ChEMBL actives and property-matched decoys. vs-multitarget-benchmark-data-v2.0.zip holds the library tables with SMILES and active/decoy labels, the curated active sets and curation reports, the per-compound preparation logs for both routes, the substructure-filter reports, the docking score tables for both protocols and for the filter-ablation condition, the per-target evaluation outputs, the original Uni-Dock run scripts and the box centres. Every table in the article and its Additional file 1 regenerates from this archive with the released analysis scripts. vs_benchmark_preparation_inputs.zip holds the prepared receptor and ligand PDBQT files for both preparation routes and all eleven targets, which are needed only to re-run docking. This deposit supersedes 10.5281/zenodo.20036964, which held the score tables but not the preparation logs, the filter reports or the preparation inputs, and whose README described directories it did not contain. That record is under a different Zenodo account and could not be versioned directly, so this is a separate record that declares itself a new version of it.
